mediaWork.title: Wrongful Conviction: False Confessions
mediaWork.focusOrTheme: Sub-series of Wrongful Conviction analyzing real police interrogation audio and how innocent people are pressured into false confessions.
mediaWork.summaryNotes: Hosted by Northwestern Center on Wrongful Convictions co-directors Laura Nirider and Steve Drizin (Lava for Good). Uses real interrogation audio to dissect cases like the Norfolk Four, Matt Livers, Robert Davis, and Tommy Ward & Karl Fontenot.
